var signed_value:sbyte=-1
var unsigned_value:ushort=1

cases.name: wide-operations-preserve-outcome-flow
cases.pre: fn produce()->int fails int ensures true {fail 42}
cases.body:
let outcome=produce()
var maximum:long=9223372036854775807L
var minimum:long=-9223372036854775808L
var minus_one:long=-1L
var small:byte=1
let enabled=unchecked(maximum+small)==minimum && unchecked(minimum+minus_one)==maximum && ~maximum==minimum && unchecked(-minimum)==minimum
if(enabled){return match outcome {Ok(v)=>v,Err(e)=>e}}
return 0
